names=$(gh api -X GET repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels -f per_page=100 --paginate --jq '.[].name') && k=1 || k=0; i=0; for l in '__L1__' '__L2__'; do i=$((i+1)); x=0; if [ "$k" = 1 ] && ! printf '%s\n' "$names" | grep -Fxiq -- "$l"; then x=1; fi; out=$(gh api -X GET repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues -f state=open -f labels="$l" -f per_page=100 --paginate --jq '.[]|select(.pull_request==null)|.number') && printf %s "$out" | jq -sc --argjson i "$i" --argjson x "$x" '{number: ($i * 2 + $x), deps: unique} | .sig = ((((.number * 7919) % 1000000007) + ([.deps | to_entries[] | (((.key + 1) * .value * 104729) % 1000000007)] | add // 0)) % 1000000007) | {i: $i, x: $x, numbers: .deps, sig: .sig}' || echo "FAILED $i" >&2; done
